about: Test vectors for MoMo push body sealing (A6). The Mac seals (electron/remote/pushTitles.cjs sealBody), the phone opens (mobile/src/push/sealedTitle.ts openSealedBody) and the iOS extension mirrors it (mobile/plugins/Shared/SealedTitle.swift SealedTitle.openBody): all three must read each vector the same. A blob is base64url(nonce24 || XChaCha20-Poly1305 box); the plaintext is the name as UTF-8 padded with spaces to padBytes; the AAD is aadPrefix + ref.
